cases.name: postgres-event-store-valid
cases.description: An authoritative event store is accepted.

cases.name: postgres-purpose-invalid
cases.description: An unknown PostgreSQL purpose is rejected.

cases.name: postgres-authority-mismatch
cases.description: An event store without authoritative ownership is rejected.

cases.name: tenancy-valid
cases.description: Distinct tenant database and role bindings are accepted.

cases.name: tenancy-duplicate-database
cases.description: Two tenant keys cannot map to one database.

cases.name: tenancy-long-key-explicit-role
cases.description: A long logical key with a short explicit database role remains accepted.

cases.name: tenancy-derived-role-valid
cases.description: Default role derivation preserves tenant keys and replaces hyphens with underscores.

cases.name: tenancy-derived-role-too-long
cases.description: A derived database role exceeding the PostgreSQL identifier limit is rejected.

cases.name: tenancy-explicit-role-too-long
cases.description: An explicit database role exceeding the PostgreSQL identifier limit is rejected.

cases.name: redis-cache-valid
cases.description: An authenticated TLS cache contract is accepted.

cases.name: redis-retained-state-without-persistence
cases.description: Retained state cannot disable persistence.

cases.name: redis-reader-single-zone
cases.description: Dedicated reader capability requires multi-zone availability.

cases.name: node-contract-valid
cases.description: A bounded scheduling and disruption contract is accepted.

cases.name: node-capacity-invalid
cases.description: An unsupported capacity type is rejected.

cases.name: postgres-binding-valid
cases.description: A TLS binding with a dedicated reader is accepted.

cases.name: postgres-binding-reader-mismatch
cases.description: Reader capability cannot be claimed without a reader endpoint.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-single
cases.description: The single-hostname inputs publish one hostname through one tunnel.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-multi-zone
cases.description: Hostnames across different zones share one tunnel.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-combined
cases.description: The single-hostname input combines with additional hostnames on one tunnel.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-duplicate-hostname
cases.description: Duplicate hostnames are rejected case-insensitively.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-missing-origin
cases.description: A hostname with no origin of its own and no default origin is rejected.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-no-hostname
cases.description: At least one published hostname is required.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-entry-origin-invalid
cases.description: A hostname entry whose origin is not an HTTP URL is rejected.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-empty-origin
cases.description: A hostname entry with a blank origin and no default origin is rejected.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-dns-unmanaged
cases.description: DNS ownership can be delegated while the tunnel still serves every hostname.
